question: _______ option determines the distance of the paragraph from either the left or the right margin.
solution:
The correct answer is__** In**dent__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An indent increases the distance between the side of a paragraph and the left or right margin. Indented paragraphs appear to have different margin settings. Word provides a variety of indents to emphasize paragraphs in a document. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paragraph formatting** is a change in the **format** of the **text** that affects an entire **paragraph** or is **different** from other **paragraphs** in a document. **Paragraphs** in a word processing document or on a web page can have **paragraph formatting** applied to them, including font type, font size, highlighting, and indentation.
 
• **Mail merging** means to plug data from an address table into form letters, e-**mail** messages, envelopes, address labels, or a directory (a list or catalogue, for example).
 
• **Borders** are rules you can add to any or all of the four sides of a paragraph. **Shading** is the colour or artistic design you use as the background for a paragraph. **Borders and shading** are formatting tools for enhancing text, paragraphs, table cells, or frames.
 
• **Right alignment** or **right** justify is text or page formatting that aligns text along the **right** side of a page or containing element.
